name: Coded Element (Code + Qualifier)
sourceRefs: dgoradia/ncpdp testdata/sample-newrx.xml (SCRIPT v2017071, DrugCoded/ProductCode and /DrugDBCode share this <X><Code>/<Qualifier> shape; QuantityUnitOfMeasure reuses it with Qualifier absent)

fallbackXPath added (2026-09-19) after a SECOND real, independent source (cosyte/ncpdp's own MIT-licensed test fixtures) showed a genuinely different, equally real alternate shape for this SAME conceptual element: `<ProductCode Qualifier="ND">00093505601</ProductCode>` (code as the element's own text content, qualifier as an XML attribute) -- confirmed deliberate, not a fixture typo, since newrx-coded-and-strength.xml uses BOTH shapes in the SAME message (ProductCode attribute-form, sibling DrugDBCode nested-form). Found by running 33 real third-party SCRIPT fixtures through the real parse+validate pipeline: every fixture using the attribute form failed validation with 'required field Code is missing' despite carrying a real, present value. Read-side only (fallbackXPath) -- BuildDocument's own write direction is unchanged, always emitting the nested form dgoradia's own sample already confirms as valid.
